change_summary: The journal issued an expression of concern saying the editors were made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article. The notice says the matter is being looked into and readers will be updated when more information is available. The notice does not say which data or figures are affected.
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, and says your own proposal builds on this finding. The stored paper's abstract reports that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test (Figure 3). The journal's notice says the editors were made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in the article, and that the matter is being looked into. The notice does not say which data or figures are affected, so it is uncertain whether the result you rely on is touched; treating it as possibly affected, the impact on your Discussion is medium.
recommendation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, and says your own proposal builds on this finding. The journal's notice says the editors were made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in the article, but it does not say which data or figures are affected. Hedge the wording of that Discussion sentence, cite the notice, and avoid building your proposal on this finding for now.
